title: Smiling Graduate Celebrated by Family, 1966 Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square-format snapshot stamped March 1966 at the top margin shows a proud family gathering around a young female graduate dressed in cap and gown. She holds a small card or envelope while speaking with an older woman in a winter coat with a fur collar. Beside her, an elderly grandmother-figure smiles warmly wearing a brimless hat and spectacles, while another woman looks on beneath the dappled canopy of a large tree.
